name: Two numbers
why: With two numbers, the answer is their XOR: 01 ^ 10 = 11 = 3.

name: Zeros
why: 0. Watch out for max(nums).bit_length() being 0: the walk then has no bits at all, which is fine.

name: Large values
why: (2³⁰ − 1) ^ 0 = 1,073,741,823. All 30 bits matter: if you used fewer bits, the top ones were lost.

name: Powers of two
why: 64 ^ 32 = 96. No two powers share a bit.

name: The opposite bit is missing
why: All four start with bit 8, so the top result bit is 0 for every pair. The best is 8 ^ 11 = 1000 ^ 1011 = 0011 = 3, or 9 ^ 10.

name: 20,000 numbers
why: Comparing every pair is 200 million XORs. A trie of bits needs about 20,000 × 60 steps.
